message.reasoning:
We need to answer who were the kings of France during the 18th century (1701-1800). The user asks "who were the kings". We can provide names with reign periods.

The question likely expects listing Louis XV (1715–1774), Louis XVI (1774–1792) until monarchy abolished; also mention Louis XVIII after restoration but that's early 19th century. Also maybe mention King Charles X later. But only 18th century includes up to 1799. So we should include:

Louis XIV died 1715, so his successor was Louis XV from 1715 to 1774. Then Louis XVI from 1774 to 1792 when he was executed. After that monarchy ended. There might have been no king between 1792 and 1814 except Napoleon's Emperor. So just those two.

But some may consider Louis XV reigned until 1774, then Louis XVI until 1792. Provide details like dates, context.

Also could use function calls if needed. There's a function European history get monarchs. Let's call it for France, 18th century. That will give us data. Use function.
